from Casekept: The Gaslight Files, the case files of the fictional London enquiry agents Hatherley & Quill. Christmas edition.

On Thursday 20 December 1894, the jewellers Garrow & Pike sent Mrs. Felix Thorne's pearl necklace to her house in Kensington by registered post, a Christmas present from her husband. On Friday morning the parcel came to her door with every seal intact. Inside, the case was empty. The police have charged the young sorting clerk who was alone with the parcel for a quarter of an hour. He owes money and he has lied to them, and he will spend Christmas in a cell unless someone can show where the pearls went. Five people had their hands on the necklace or the parcel, or a reason to want it gone. Every one of them has told somebody something untrue. You have one day before the magistrate sits again.
